settings.subtitle: Rotalla is a budget-friendly Chinese tire brand offering surprisingly strong 3PMSF-rated options — we stock 130 active SKUs including the SETULA 4SEASON (all-weather, 3PMSF) and WINTER RACE S130 / S500 dedicated winters at 111 42 Ave SW.
settings.intro_heading: Why we recommend Rotalla in Calgary
settings.intro_richtext:
Rotalla is a Chinese tire manufacturer (Shandong Yongtai) that we stock for Calgary drivers looking for legitimate winter capability at a budget price. Among budget-tier brands, Rotalla stands out for actually carrying 3PMSF (three-peak mountain snowflake) certification on its SETULA 4SEASON all-weather and dedicated winter lines.

The SETULA 4SEASON is the budget-tier all-weather option we recommend most — 3PMSF rated, meets Alberta winter law year-round, and runs about half the price of a Michelin CrossClimate2 in matched sizes.

For dedicated winter, the WINTER RACE S130 is the studless option and the WINTER RACE S500 is studdable — both cold-Canadian-winter rated. Right pick for second cars, older vehicles, and Calgary drivers who want real winter capability without paying for premium tread life.

Every Rotalla we install gets the same balance, calibrated torque, and TPMS reset as our premium-priced jobs — and we price-match local Calgary competitors. Book installation or call (403) 452-4283.
settings.cta_description: Stocked Rotalla sizes installed same-day. Same balance and warranty handling as our premium installs.
settings.faq_1_q: Is Rotalla a good tire brand?
settings.faq_1_a: For its price tier, yes. Rotalla is a Chinese-manufactured brand with DOT and ECE certification. Their SETULA 4SEASON and WINTER RACE lines are 3PMSF-rated, which is unusual for the budget tier — most Chinese budget brands skip the cold-Canadian-winter certification.
settings.faq_2_q: What's the best Rotalla tire for Calgary winters?
settings.faq_2_a: For one-tire-year-round, the SETULA 4SEASON (3PMSF) — meets Alberta winter law, no seasonal swap needed. For dedicated winter, the WINTER RACE S130 (studless) or WINTER RACE S500 (studdable, 174 studs for icy rural runs east of Calgary).
settings.faq_3_q: How much do Rotalla tires cost in Calgary?
settings.faq_3_a: Rotalla tires at Prince Tires range from $85 to $160 per tire — about 50-65% less than premium-tier equivalents. SETULA 4SEASON starts around $88 in 15" sizes; WINTER RACE S130 from $90; WINTER RACE S500 (studdable) from $100.
settings.faq_4_a: Yes — verified on the sidewall. It carries the three-peak mountain snowflake symbol, which means it meets the same Transport Canada and Alberta winter-tire standard as Michelin CrossClimate2 or Bridgestone WeatherPeak. The compound and tread life aren't premium-tier, but the cold-weather grip is real.
settings.faq_5_q: When does Rotalla make sense for a Calgary driver?
settings.faq_5_a: Rotalla SETULA 4SEASON is our most-recommended budget all-weather. Right pick for: drivers who want a no-swap option but can't justify Michelin CrossClimate2 money, fleet operators needing 3PMSF compliance at scale, second cars or older vehicles, drivers between premium tire purchase cycles.
settings.faq_6_q: Can I get same-day Rotalla install in Calgary?
settings.faq_6_a: Yes for most stocked sizes — Rotalla has good inventory depth at our shop. SETULA 4SEASON and WINTER RACE in common 14-17" sedan sizes are reliably in stock. Call (403) 452-4283 to confirm.
settings.calgary_richtext: Rotalla is one of our cheapest 3PMSF-rated winter options — RM958 in particular. Setula handling on dry pavement is respectable; you're trading peak-grip ceiling for upfront cost. Good fit for older Civics, Corollas, third-vehicle pickups — anything where the math works better at $130/tire than $260.
settings.awards_text: 3PMSF certified across its winter-tire line. ECE-approved manufacturing.
settings.testimonial_quote: Rotalla winters on the Corolla. -28°C on Macleod last January, no issues. You don't need premium for a daily commuter.
